verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing content about DLSS, AI features, and CUDA tools plus one community review praising cooling quietness, but no published TDP/TGP figures, PSU/connector requirements (e.g., 12VHPWR), or specific cooling design guidance for the RTX 5070 Ti. Missing for 10: TDP/TGP wattage spec, power connector type/PSU wattage recommendation, official cooling/thermal guidance for this card.
